s.g: An exclamation used to startle or frighten.
(martial arts) A quarterstaff, especially in an oriental context.
(Singlish, interrogative) Final interrogative particle, used to invite agreement.
(Singlish, interrogative) Final interrogative particle, forming a yes-no question from a declarative statement.

bo.f: (informal, euphemistic, uncountable) Initialism of body odor or body odour.
